purpose.summary: Portable orchestration runtime for structured AI-assisted software development.
purpose.runtime_role: Routes, sequences, constrains, validates, records, and coordinates specialist AI-assisted development work without treating tool access or validation success as authority.
purpose.core_trust_boundary: Governance approval, coordination readiness, validation success, GitHub mergeability, and host capability are evidence or state signals and do not independently grant or expand authority.

machine_scan_order.purpose: Repository orientation and canonical machine-surface index
Package identity, version, command manifest, and installable specialist manifest
Compiled specialist identities and routing-relevant metadata
Deterministic command routing, direct routes, ordered sequences, aliases, and fallback
Governance vocabulary, precedence, ownership, validation rules, and remediation defaults
Third-party dependencies, references, source-use classification, license identifiers, and incorporation boundaries
JSON Schema contracts for machine-authoritative records
Human-readable project continuity and implementation chronology
Human-oriented project overview, rationale, architecture explanation, and release narrative

specialists.source_of_truth_note: Specialist prose and reasoning guidance remain in skills/*/SKILL.md; machine routing-critical metadata is compiled and parity-validated.

governance.effective_authority_model: selected_profile INTERSECTION explicit_grant INTERSECTION repository_policy INTERSECTION host_capability INTERSECTION current_phase INTERSECTION current_evidence

validation.mutation_evidence_policy: Mutation scores are scope-specific and valid only when the configured unmutated baseline passes, all scheduled mutation jobs complete, and the machine-readable evidence artifact binds the tested checkout SHA and source-head SHA.
validation.evidence_policy: Runtime confidence claims must be derived from persisted machine-readable CI evidence bound to the tested checkout SHA and source-head SHA.

representation_policy.markdown: Human-readable explanation, rationale, examples, and nuanced specialist guidance
representation_policy.json: Machine-readable state, identity, routing, governance, receipts, manifests, provenance, and indexes
representation_policy.jsonl: Append-only event/history records where incremental retrieval is preferable
representation_policy.parity_rule: When the same deterministic fact appears in more than one representation, CI must validate parity or derive the projection from one authoritative source.
